source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Battle with the lingering shadow of a legendary demon lord: epic, dark and legendary, gothic grandeur and dread. Tempo 158 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor. Instrumentation: organ, wordless choir (no words), brass, fast strings, heavy drums, harpsichord flourishes. Form: short intro, dark riff, brass theme, organ bridge, theme again. Duration: 90 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
